lines.trans: Alisa, how do you like my restaurant?
Dad, look, do I look like you?
Of course, sunshine!
You have my eyes and smile.
And mom says something else.
She says, thank God, you do not look like him!
She was just joking.
Do not pay any attention.
Are you handsome too, Dad?
I am the most handsome chef in Moscow!
But mom says you are very funny.
Mom is simply jealous of my talent.
Then let us keep playing!
